caseName: Carter v. United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit
caseNameFull: Carter v. United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit

opinions.text: Motion for leave to file petition for writ of mandamus denied. Motion for leave to proceed m forma pauperis granted. Treating the papers submitted as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari granted and case remanded to the United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit for further consideration in light of the memorandum for respondent filed by the Solicitor General in this Court on December 19, 1972.
